about: The fight-classes sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

ability_backstab.use: Sneak Jab: a quick thin cut and the slap.
ability_backstab.anchor: die_land_a_1.wav at gain 1; target 1 dB relative to it
